text:
mike_marketing: Hey runtime  need a fast validation for the blog + webinar: 1) per-token cost delta quant vs fp16, 2) p95 coldstart (single-request UX). Keep payloads <=128 tokens. Can you run a compact spotprobe and hand over a tiny reproducible bundle (CSV, traces, demo command, one-line caveat)?

sara_runtime: On it. We'll measure batch=1, concurrency=1 in us-west1 hosted. We'll run: coldstart (fresh node), short steady (1min @ qps=2). Deliverables: p50/p95 CSV, per-1k-token cost estimate, raw trace snippets, and a demo tarball. ETA: 5h.

juan_bench: Also planning a rerun with randomized warmup order and an isolated local run (no autoscaler) so marketing can demo stable numbers on stage. We'll include the tiny payload set you should use.

mike_marketing: Nice. Please include a tiny JSON we can attach to leads: {"bench_artifact_id": "<id>", "suggested_sales_tags": []} and a one-line caveat we can paste under the metric.

sara_runtime: We'll fill bench_artifact_id in the bundle. Local reproduce example (no autoscaler):
```bash
docker run --rm -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=$REDWOOD_API_KEY -v $(pwd)/payloads:/app/payloads redwood/bench:stable /app/run.sh \
  --model rwd-gen4-small-quant --endpoint http://localhost:8080/v1/generate \
  --payloads /app/payloads/webinar.json --warmup 25 --duration 40 --concurrency 1
```

juan_bench: Cloud run command used for hosted numbers:
./bench/run.sh --model rwd-gen4-small-quant --endpoint https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate --payloads marketing/webinar-payloads.json --warmup 30 --duration 120 --concurrency 1 --region us-west1

benchbot: benchmark job 2076543222 created for rwd-gen4-small-quant (tags: webinar, marketing).

infra-bot: Reminder: hosted autoscaler can change coldstart. Recommend this exact caveat: "Measured with single-request settings (batch=1, concurrency=1) in us-west1; results may vary by workload, region, or deployment mode."

sara_runtime: Uploaded artifacts -> https://s3.redwood.ai/marketing/2076543222/ (CSV, traces, payloads.json, demo.tar.gz, README). bench_artifact_id: 2076543222. Suggested sales_tags: ["webinar-lead","demo-interested","plg-trial"].

mike_marketing: Perfect. Can you also flag any trace ids for spikes so we can call them out transparently?

juan_bench: We saw one 4.9s spike during quant coldstart (trace id: trace-2076543233), due to node initialization; included condensed trace and note in README. Otherwise runs were stable.

mike_marketing: Great transparency  we'll link the S3 bundle in the post, paste infra-bot caveat under the metric, and add bench_artifact_id to the webinar signup payload so Sales can route leads automatically. Any notes on methodology we should paste in speaker notes?

sara_runtime: Paste this short bullet: "How we measured: single-request (batch=1, concurrency=1), payloads <=128 tokens, warmup 30s, runs in us-west1 hosted. Local demo uses the provided Docker image to avoid autoscaler variance."

sales-bot: Suggested CRM mapping: crm.custom_fields.bench_artifact_id = 2076543222, tags -> ["webinar-lead","latency-interest"].

mike_marketing: Thanks all  will slot the caveat + methodology into the slide notes and wire the bench_artifact_id into the signup form. Ping here if you rerun or find anything surprising. :sparkles:
